profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Software developer with over fifteen years of experience developing full stack applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer - visionOS Keyboards and Inputs
Software Engineer - iOS and macOS Mail App
Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
• Implement front end interfaces and back end logic for Oracleʼs Diameter Signaling Routing web-based
application. 
• Established synchronous database and alarm monitoring system in C++. 
• Collaborate with project management team to develop and analyze functional requirements of
new features.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Optimized PHP and SQL logic to boost performance of a rapidly growing database and
decrease page-loading times by 97%. 
• Developed and maintained web-based applications comprised of PHP, JavaScript and HTML. 
• Constructed a SOAP server with WSSE Authentication for 3rd party polling of configuration
data.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
• Programmed a Perl parser for converting XML definitions to C code at build time in order to
reduce the level of effort for engineers to develop new data structures by 30%. 
• Created a Command Line Interface in PHP including options for displaying debugging
information and stack traces for use across multiple products. 
• Built PHP and XML based tools to test SOAP interfaces.
